description: Add the shared LIST_FINANCE_PATH constant and the batch entry point: a new COMMAND_BATCH command in InitiateEsignCommandSet (declared in the manifest) that appears ONLY in the Finance library (/sites/DMS/Finance), mutually exclusive with COMMAND_1, and redirects to the initiate page carrying multiple fileRefs. Independent of FEAT-002/FEAT-003 at build time, but defines the fileRefs query-param contract that FEAT-002 consumes, so it goes first.
steps: In src/extensions/initiateEsign/InitiateEsignCommandSet.manifest.json, add a COMMAND_BATCH entry to the `items` map: `"title": { "default": "Request Signature (Batch)" }`, `"type": "command"`, and an `iconImageUrl` reusing an existing data-URI icon (e.g. copy COMMAND_1's value) to avoid adding a new asset. Leave COMMAND_1/COMMAND_2/COMMAND_3 untouched.
In src/extensions/initiateEsign/InitiateEsignCommandSet.ts, extend the imports to include LIST_FINANCE_PATH and SITE_REDIRECT from ../../common/constants.

In _updateCommandVisibility(), after the existing COMMAND_1/2/3 logic (do NOT change it), get `tryGetCommand("COMMAND_BATCH")` and compute Finance-library detection: `this.context.pageContext.web.serverRelativeUrl.toLowerCase().indexOf(LIST_FINANCE_PATH.toLowerCase()) === 0` (case-insensitive; optionally also check the current list root folder path).

Set COMMAND_BATCH visible only when in the Finance library AND ((count of selected rows that are PDFs >= 2) OR (exactly one selected row is a folder)). Detect folders via the row value `getValueByName("FSObjType") === "1"` (fallback: a FileLeafRef with no .pdf/file extension); detect PDFs via FileLeafRef ending `.pdf`. Keep COMMAND_BATCH hidden when exactly 1 PDF is selected (COMMAND_1 handles that) and whenever location is not Finance. Call this.raiseOnChange() consistent with existing code.

Add a `case "COMMAND_BATCH":` in onExecute. Build an SPFI against the DMS site: `getSP(this.context, `${TENANT_DOMAIN}/${SITE_REDIRECT}`)`. For each selected row: if PDF file, collect its FileRef (getValueByName("FileRef")); if folder, enumerate PDFs inside with PnPjs (e.g. sp.web.getFolderByServerRelativePath(folderRef).files() and/or filtered items) and collect their FileRefs. Deduplicate the resulting array.

If 0 PDFs after expansion: Dialog.alert('No PDF files found in the selection.') and return. Otherwise (including exactly 1 PDF, with a code comment noting it proceeds as a 1-document batch) redirect: `window.location.href = `${TENANT_DOMAIN}/${SITES_ESIGN}/SitePages/${PAGE_INITIATE_ESIGN}?fileRefs=${encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(fileRefs))}&source=${encodeURIComponent(this.context.pageContext.web.absoluteUrl)}`;`. Do not alter the COMMAND_1 redirect.
acceptance_criteria: The manifest declares COMMAND_BATCH with title 'Request Signature (Batch)' and COMMAND_1/2/3 entries are unchanged.

COMMAND_BATCH visibility and onExecute are implemented so it shows only in the Finance library for (>=2 PDFs) or (1 folder), never when 1 PDF is selected, and never outside Finance; executing it redirects to RequestSignatures.aspx with a `fileRefs` query param holding a URI-encoded JSON array of server-relative URLs.
`npm run build` exits 0 with no TypeScript/ESLint errors.
verification: Run `npm install` in the worktree if node_modules is absent (first feature), then `npm run build` and confirm it exits 0 with no TypeScript or ESLint errors.
Confirm the new command compiles and the manifest validates (build includes manifest schema checks).
findings:
IMPLEMENTED. Build (npm run build) exits 0; the only 7 lint warnings are pre-existing in files not touched by this feature (ApprovalService.ts, EsignDataService.ts, UserService.ts, Sidebar.tsx). 

fileRefs query-param contract (FEAT-002 consumes this): the batch redirect navigates to `${TENANT_DOMAIN}/${SITES_ESIGN}/SitePages/${PAGE_INITIATE_ESIGN}?fileRefs=<ENC>&source=<ENC>`. `fileRefs` = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(string[])) where the array holds DEDUPLICATED server-relative URLs (e.g. ["/sites/DMS/Finance/a.pdf","/sites/DMS/Finance/sub/b.pdf"]). So FEAT-002 must JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(fileRefs)) to get a string[] of server-relative FileRefs. `source` = encodeURIComponent of the current web absoluteUrl (the Finance library web). NOTE: this differs from COMMAND_1's single-doc param which is `fileRef` (singular, a raw server-relative URL, not JSON). Both params may exist across the two flows; FEAT-002 should detect batch mode by the presence of `fileRefs`.

Folder-detection / PDF-collection approach: In both _updateCommandVisibility and the COMMAND_BATCH onExecute case, folders are detected via row.getValueByName("FSObjType") === "1" (compared as string) with a fallback of FileLeafRef containing no '.' ; PDFs via FileLeafRef.toLowerCase().endsWith(".pdf"). onExecute reads cross-site against the DMS site with getSP(this.context, `${TENANT_DOMAIN}/${SITE_REDIRECT}`) and expands each selected folder with sp.web.getFolderByServerRelativePath(folderFileRef).files(), keeping files whose Name ends .pdf and collecting their ServerRelativeUrl. Directly-selected PDF rows contribute getValueByName("FileRef"). The final array is de-duplicated via new Set(). 0 PDFs after expansion -> Dialog.alert('No PDF files found in the selection.') and return; otherwise redirect (1 PDF proceeds as a 1-document batch, documented in a code comment). 

Visibility rule: COMMAND_BATCH is visible only when web.serverRelativeUrl starts (index 0) with LIST_FINANCE_PATH (/sites/DMS/Finance, case-insensitive) AND ((>=2 selected PDFs) OR (exactly one row selected and it is a folder)). Hidden for exactly 1 selected PDF (COMMAND_1 owns that) and anywhere outside Finance. COMMAND_1/2/3 logic was left untouched; batch visibility is computed in a separate block appended to _updateCommandVisibility. Added `import "@pnp/sp/folders"` and `import "@pnp/sp/files"` for folder/file enumeration. Manifest: COMMAND_BATCH added to items with title 'Request Signature (Batch)', type 'command', iconImageUrl copied from COMMAND_1 (reused existing data-URI, no new asset); COMMAND_1/2/3 entries unchanged (note: the manifest JSON was reserialized to 2-space indentation but values are identical).
